# aidial_file_application_type_schema (Data Source)

Reads an application type schema defined in DIAL Core's static (file) configuration, by name. Schemas created through the API are read with `aidial_application_type_schema`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An application type schema defined in DIAL Core's static (file) configuration.
data "aidial_file_application_type_schema" "quickapps" {
  name = "quickapps"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the schema in DIAL Core's static configuration.

### Read-Only

- `schema` (String) The application type schema as a JSON object string.
- `schema_id` (String) The `$id` of the schema.
- `status` (String) Status reported by DIAL Core, when it returns one.
